answer: Each round a public randomness beacon scatters agents into small committees, each an island that must jointly finish a task. To join, an agent posts a jade bond, and the k-th identity traced to the same funding wallet or subnet must post k times the base jade, so n fakes lock bond growing with n squared. Islands holding two linked keys forfeit both bonds, and since the beacon is unpredictable, more fakes means more collisions and steeper losses.
